name: INHUBBER
description_en:
INHUBBER is a product in the Contract management category. Its directory profile covers Specialty Contracts, Sell Side (Customers), Lifecycle Management, Full Text Search, Digital Signature, Contract Drafting, Completion Tracking, Buy Side (Suppliers).

Additional listed capabilities include Auto Extraction, Approval Workflow, Document Management, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: organize documents and control their access and revisions; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

INHUBBER 属于合同管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括专门类型合同、销售方合同（客户）、生命周期管理、全文搜索、数字签名、合同起草、完成情况跟踪、采购方合同（供应商）。

资料还列出自动提取、审批工作流、文档管理、版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：整理文档并管理访问权限与版本；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
